platform: ground, NASA White Sands Test Facility (NASA-STD-6001B Test 1)
snippet: The webbings had MOCs of 37% and 35% oxygen for the natural and black webbing, respectively, at 8.2 psia.
source_title: NESC Technical Bulletin No. 26-05, Webbings for Use in Elevated Oxygen Environments (NTRS 20260006043)
condition_notes: Test Methods/Data Collection: The MOC test refers to the maximum oxygen concentration at which a minimum of five samples tested pass the NASA-STD-6001B criteria at a fixed pressure.
